title: A sharper Session Recorder
question: Same compact Linear / Raycast direction. Three ways to arrange the full-page report after recording.

options.label: Report first
options.thesis: Read the bug, skim the evidence, file the issue.
options.viewport: A compact navigation rail, readable issue draft, evidence below, and File issue fixed in the header.
options.risk: The screenshot sits below the summary; best when the written report leads.

options.label: Evidence beside the draft
options.thesis: See the captured problem while reading or editing its summary.
options.viewport: A large evidence viewer and compact event strip beside the issue draft; File issue stays in the header.
options.risk: The split view needs more width, and collapses into sections on smaller screens.

options.label: Recording as a timeline
options.thesis: Follow the reproduction in order, then file the resulting report.
options.viewport: A dense timeline with a selected screenshot and annotation, plus a concise issue summary.
options.risk: More investigation-oriented; may be too much interface for quick filing.
